description: This Python file implements backend logic for a dashboard chart in an ERP system, specifically for generating an account balance timeline visualization. It includes functions for fetching account balances, processing GL entries, and generating date ranges based on specified time grains.

methods.name: get(chart_name = None, chart = None, no_cache = None, filters = None, from_date = None, to_date = None, timespan = None, time_interval = None, heatmap_year = None)
methods.description: Main entry point for retrieving chart data, processes chart parameters, filters, and date ranges, and returns labels and dataset values for visualization.

methods.name: build_result(account, dates, gl_entries)
methods.description: Constructs balance data over a sequence of dates based on general ledger entries and account type.

methods.name: get_gl_entries(account, to_date)
methods.description: Fetches general ledger entries for an account and its descendants up to a specified date.

methods.name: get_dates_from_timegrain(from_date, to_date, timegrain)
methods.description: Generates a list of period-ending dates between 'from_date' and 'to_date' based on the specified time grain (daily, weekly, monthly, quarterly).
